# Lumora Bellydance Event Directory

> LumoraEvents' public international directory for bellydance and oriental dance events. It helps dancers, teachers, organizers and audiences discover festivals, competitions, congresses, workshops, masterclasses, galas and other bellydance gatherings around the world.

The primary language of the directory is English and is served from the root path. The Spanish version is served under `/es/`.

Use the root URL for English-language information and `/es/` for Spanish-language information.

## English

- [Bellydance Event Directory](https://bellydance.lumoraevents.net/): Search and browse upcoming bellydance and oriental dance events worldwide by event name, country and month. The directory includes festivals, competitions, congresses, workshops, masterclasses, galas and other gatherings.
- [Privacy Policy](https://bellydance.lumoraevents.net/privacy-policy.html): Privacy information for the Bellydance Event Directory.
- [Cookie Policy](https://bellydance.lumoraevents.net/cookie-policy.html): Cookie information for the Bellydance Event Directory.
- [Legal Notice](https://bellydance.lumoraevents.net/legal-notice.html): Legal information for the Bellydance Event Directory.

## Español

- [Directorio de eventos de Bellydance](https://bellydance.lumoraevents.net/es/): Busca y explora próximos eventos de bellydance y danza oriental en todo el mundo por nombre, país y mes. El directorio reúne festivales, competiciones, congresos, talleres, masterclasses, galas y otros encuentros.
- [Política de privacidad](https://bellydance.lumoraevents.net/privacy-policy.html): Información de privacidad del directorio.
- [Política de cookies](https://bellydance.lumoraevents.net/cookie-policy.html): Información sobre cookies del directorio.
- [Aviso legal](https://bellydance.lumoraevents.net/legal-notice.html): Información legal del directorio.

## Directory purpose

The directory is intended as a practical discovery tool for the international bellydance community.

Users can use it to:

- Find upcoming bellydance and oriental dance events.
- Search events by name.
- Filter events by country.
- Filter events by month.
- Discover festivals, competitions, congresses and other gatherings.
- Find workshops, masterclasses and galas.
- Access practical information published for each listed event.
- Discover events outside their own country.
- Contact LumoraEvents to suggest an event that is not yet listed.

Event listings are loaded dynamically by the website, so the homepage is the main discovery entry point for current directory content.

## Submit or suggest an event

If an event is missing from the directory, organizers or community members can contact LumoraEvents:

- Email: bellydance@lumoraevents.net
